items.quote: Dubai property prices dropped almost fifty percent in less than a year. I'm talking about two thousand eight.
items.statement: Dubai property prices dropped almost fifty percent in less than a year in 2008.

items.quote: In two thousand eight, the market was built on credit. Buyers were getting up to ninety percent finance.
items.statement: In 2008, the market was built on credit, allowing buyers to obtain up to ninety percent finance.

items.quote: Today, most purchases are cash. Mortgage lending is restricted and offline is regulated.
items.statement: Today, most purchases in Dubai are cash due to restricted mortgage lending.

items.quote: the risk is not identical, but that doesn't mean that there is no risk.
items.statement: The speaker believes that while risks are not identical today compared to 2008, there are still risks in the market.

items.quote: In the full video, I explain what could actually pressure Dubai property prices in this cycle.
items.statement: The speaker offers to explain what could pressure Dubai property prices in the current cycle in a full video.
